kjv: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

lines.say: Too much noise in your head tonight? Hear this.
lines.big: Too much noise in your head tonight

lines.say: Turn the noise down and listen. He speaks peace to his people.

lines.say: Lord, speak peace to me tonight. I'm listening. In Jesus' name, amen.
